visual_encoder: One shared frozen DINOv2-vits14. No separate runtime context/EMA-target encoder pair in this released Push world model.
target_encoder_key: pretrain_enc_ckpt_key:target_encoder is consumed only by the V-JEPA loader branch, not the selected DINO branch.
proprio_caveat: Proprio encoder is included in optimizer; one-step target is not explicitly detached in compute_loss. Rollout history and targets are detached. Do not call all training target representations fixed.
masking: Temporal block-causal attention with all current/past-frame spatial patches; this world-model path does not perform spatial masked-patch target reconstruction. DINO forward_features called without masks.
RGB_head: Our loader clears heads_cfg. Native planning scores visual MSE + alpha times proprio MSE directly; RGB decoding is optional visualization, not objective input.
limitations: Historical training YAML is consistent with folder/tag/epoch but not cryptographically bound inside checkpoint metadata.
External DINO pretrained weights and Hub revision are not bundled in predictor checkpoint9bec alone.
DINO original pretraining mechanisms are distinct from active EMA during these frozen experiments; no active target drift follows from pretraining history.
